value.hook: read when a pane's input line shows text nobody typed
value.title: Stray text on a Copilot input line may be screen-only

sections.name: body
sections.value: 08 Nov 13:42: herring's input line showed 'nfs server OrbStack:/OrbStack: is alive again', an OS console message written to the tty. The prime checked: it was drawn on screen only, not in the composer buffer (one typed char plus one backspace left the input empty), and it clears at the next redraw. A capture can't tell screen-only text from real unsent input. Still report it to the prime (the PA may not type into panes), but say it may be screen-only. The prime tests with one typed character and a backspace.
